title: SAP’s reported job cuts, next to other software firms that tied cuts to AI this year
intro: Slide across the companies to see what each said it would cut and why, as listed by CNBC, then the US total counted by Challenger, Gray & Christmas.
note: All figures are copied from CNBC’s report of 27 November 2026. SAP’s number is Bloomberg’s report from unnamed sources, and SAP says no decisions have been made. The other three are what each company said, with the reasons CNBC gave, and they differ, so they are not a like-for-like count. Nothing is added up or estimated here.
